products.name: Twist chicken shredder with clear lid
products.short_note: Put cooked chicken in, lid on, twist. The clear lid lets you watch it shred. Handy for tacos, salads and holiday leftovers.
products.image_alt: Bowl of freshly shredded chicken inside a twist shredder
products.headline: Shred chicken without two forks: just twist
products.intro: This is a bowl with plastic teeth inside and a clear lid on top. You put in cooked meat, close it and twist, and you can see through the lid when it's done. It's a small thing that makes tacos, enchiladas and leftover turkey a lot less messy.
why_we_like: Twist to shred instead of pulling meat apart with two forks
Clear lid so you can see when it's shredded enough
Anti-slip base and an ergonomic handle
Dishwasher safe and BPA free, with a cleaning brush included
Works for chicken, pork and beef
good_to_know: Use cooked meat only. The maker says raw meat can damage the spikes.
Cut bigger pieces smaller first and shred in a few batches.
Comes in many colours; the one in our video may look different from the default.
products.who_its_for: Anyone who meal-preps shredded chicken or wants an easy way through Thanksgiving leftovers.

faq.q: Can I shred raw chicken in it?
faq.a: No. The maker says to cook the meat first; raw meat can damage the spikes.
Yes, the listing says it's dishwasher safe, and a cleaning brush comes with it.

faq.q: Does it work for other meat?
faq.a: The listing mentions chicken, pork and beef, for things like tacos and pulled pork.

products.name: Ninja PREPi 5-in-1 Prep & Store System (PN301)
products.short_note: Slices, shreds, crinkle-cuts, chops and purees straight into a bowl, then the same bowl gets a lid and goes in the fridge.
products.image_alt: Ninja PREPi base on a counter with a bowl of fresh guacamole
products.headline: Ninja PREPi: prep it and store it in the same bowl
products.intro: The PREPi is a compact 500-watt base with a feed chute and discs that slice, shred and crinkle-cut right into the bowl underneath. Swap in the blade and it chops or purees. When you're done, snap a lid on the bowl and put it straight in the fridge.
why_we_like: Five jobs in one: crinkle cut, chop, puree, slice and shred
Food goes straight into the bowl, so there's less to wash
Two bowls (5-cup and 7-cup), each with its own storage lid
One reversible disc: slice on one side, shred on the other
Compact base that doesn't take over the counter
good_to_know: It's a prep machine, not a blender for drinks.
Check the parts list on the listing so you know which discs come in the box.
products.who_its_for: Meal-preppers, busy families and anyone cooking a big holiday meal. Also a nice gift for someone who loves to cook.

faq.a: It crinkle-cuts, chops, purees, slices and shreds, using the included blade and discs.

faq.q: Can I store food in the bowl?
faq.a: Yes. Both bowls come with storage lids, so you can prep, cover and put the bowl in the fridge.
One 5-cup bowl and one 7-cup bowl.

products.name: The Pink Stuff cleaning paste
products.short_note: One pink paste for tiles, sinks, glass, window frames and garden furniture. Wipe it on with a damp sponge and rinse it off.
products.image_alt: Tub of The Pink Stuff paste next to a shower tray being scrubbed
products.headline: One pink paste, lots of cleaning jobs
products.intro: The Pink Stuff is a cleaning paste you work in with a damp cloth or sponge and then rinse away. The brand suggests it for kitchens, bathrooms and outdoor surfaces. It's a good one to grab before holiday guests arrive.
why_we_like: One tub for many spots: sinks, tiles, grout, glass and stovetops
Also suggested for window frames (uPVC) and garden furniture
Simple to use: damp sponge, work it in, rinse
The brand describes it as non-scratch on stainless steel, ceramic, porcelain and glass
good_to_know: It's an abrasive paste, so try a small hidden spot first on anything delicate.
products.who_its_for: Anyone doing a deep clean, especially before guests come over for the holidays.

faq.a: Put a little on a damp cloth or sponge, work it into the surface, then rinse clean.
The listing mentions sinks, tiles, grout, glass, stovetops, ovens, uPVC window frames and garden furniture.

products.name: OTOTO Dunk N' Egg basketball yolk separator
products.short_note: A tiny basketball hoop for your bowl: crack the egg over it, the white drops through and the yolk stays in the net.
products.image_alt: Basketball hoop egg separator on a glass bowl next to a dish of yolks
products.headline: Separating eggs just became a game
products.intro: Dunk N' Egg is a yolk separator shaped like a basketball hoop. Crack an egg over the net, the white falls into the bowl and the yolk stays behind. It's useful for holiday baking and makes a fun small gift.
why_we_like: Separates yolk from white without passing it between shells
Fun basketball design that gets a laugh
The maker also suggests it for poached eggs, meringues and portion control
Rinses clean under warm water
good_to_know: It's a small, single-purpose gadget, so think of it as a fun extra.
Comes in a couple of colour options; ours is white and orange.
products.who_its_for: Bakers, kids helping in the kitchen, and basketball fans. A good stocking stuffer.

faq.a: Crack the egg over the hoop. The white drips through into the bowl and the yolk stays in the net.
The listing says to rinse it under warm water.

products.name: Silicone Christmas garland hangers (24 pcs, brown)
products.short_note: Stick the base down, press, wait ten seconds, then strap the garland in. Made for mantels, stair rails and shelves, with no drilling.
products.image_alt: Console table decorated with a green garland held by brown silicone hangers
products.headline: Hang Christmas garland without drilling
products.intro: These are stretchy silicone straps with a self-adhesive base. You stick the base where you want the garland, press it hard, wait a few seconds, and loop the strap around the garland. It's a simple way to dress a mantel, a stair rail or a shelf for the holidays.
why_we_like: No drilling or nails: a self-adhesive base plus a silicone strap
24 hangers in the pack, enough for a long garland
Stretchy silicone that wraps around thick garland
Brown color that blends in with the greenery
Also handy as general clips and bundlers around the house
good_to_know: Clean the spot first, press hard and wait at least ten seconds before hanging, as the maker says.
Our video shows a console table; the maker lists mantels, stair rails, banisters and shelves.
Try one on your surface first before doing the whole run.
products.who_its_for: Anyone decorating for Christmas who doesn't want holes in the mantel or stair rail.

faq.a: No. The base is self-adhesive and the strap loops around the garland.

faq.q: How do I put them up?
faq.a: Clean the spot, peel the backing, press hard, wait about ten seconds, then loop the strap around the garland and fasten it.

faq.q: How many are in the pack?
faq.a: 24 brown silicone hangers, each about 7.9 inches long.

products.name: Adjustable pots & pans organizer rack (6-tier)
products.short_note: An adjustable rack that turns a messy pan cabinet into neat tiers. The height and tiers adjust, and it fits pots up to 12 inches.
products.image_alt: Blue pans stacked on a black adjustable rack inside a kitchen cabinet
products.headline: The cabinet glow-up for your pots and pans
products.intro: Instead of stacking pans on top of each other, this rack gives each one its own tier. The side rods extend so you can set the height for your cabinet, and the tiers move to fit different pan sizes. It's an easy fix before the holiday cooking starts.
why_we_like: Every pan gets its own tier, so no more digging through a stack
Height adjusts from 14 to about 24.5 inches
Holds pots and pans up to 12 inches across
Pads on each tier help stop tipping and scratches
Works in a cabinet, on the counter or on the floor
good_to_know: Pans are not included; the ones in our video are just for show.
Measure the inside of your cabinet before ordering.
The maker lists 66 lbs total and 11 lbs per tier.
products.who_its_for: Anyone whose pan cabinet is a mess, especially before a big holiday meal.

faq.a: The height adjusts from 14 to about 24.5 inches. Measure your cabinet first.
No. Only the rack is included.
The listing says 66 lbs in total, or 11 lbs per tier.

products.name: 4-in-1 cup lid cleaning brush set (6-pack)
products.short_note: A small folding brush made for tumbler lids: a rim brush, a stiff corner brush for the grooves, a soft brush and straw brushes.
products.image_alt: Teal folding brush cleaning the grooves of a clear tumbler lid
products.headline: Finally get the gunk out of tumbler lids
products.intro: Tumbler lids have tiny grooves a sponge can't reach. This folding brush has a rim brush for the cup mouth, a stiff corner brush for the grooves, a soft brush for bottle nipples and a hook to pop out lid seals. The pack also comes with straw brushes.
why_we_like: Four tools in one small folding brush
Stiff corner bristles reach into lid grooves
U-shaped rim brush for the mouth of the cup
Three straw brushes in different lengths
Folds small and has a loop to hang it up to dry
good_to_know: The pack is 3 lid brushes plus 3 straw brushes.
Colors in the pack may look different from the one in our video.
products.who_its_for: Anyone who washes tumblers, travel mugs or baby bottles every day.

faq.a: Three 4-in-1 lid brushes and three straw brushes (7.9, 9.8 and 11.8 inches).

faq.q: What can I clean with it?
faq.a: Tumbler and mug lids, cup rims, straws, baby bottles and other narrow containers.

products.name: Cordless electric spin scrubber with long handle
products.short_note: A cordless spin brush on an extendable handle, for tubs, showers, tile and grout without kneeling on the floor.
products.image_alt: White cordless spin scrubber cleaning a hexagon tile shower floor
products.headline: Stop scrubbing the tub on your knees
products.intro: This is a rechargeable spin brush on a handle that extends, so you can reach the tub, the shower floor and the grout lines while standing up. Swap the brush heads for different surfaces and pick one of two speeds.
why_we_like: Cordless and rechargeable
Handle extends to three lengths, so no bending or kneeling
Two speeds; hold the button to switch
Comes with several replaceable brush heads
Made for tubs, showers, tile, grout and sinks
good_to_know: The brush head can get wet, but don't put the whole handle in water.
The handle twists to retract; don't push it straight in.

It adjusts to about 12, 43 or 54 inches.
You can dip the brush head, but the maker says not to put the main body under water.
